genius.licensingRegulator: FinCEN MSB registration and applicable state money-transmitter regulators for Bridge Building Inc. The OCC preliminary conditional approval applies to proposed Bridge National Trust Bank, not the current USDB issuer.
genius.notes: Bridge Building Inc. is the current USDB issuer under MSB/state money-transmitter permissions. OCC Corporate Decision 1365 granted preliminary conditional organization approval to separate proposed Bridge National Trust Bank, not BBI or USDB under GENIUS; the decision describes a planned transition of USDB to a New York limited-purpose trust company and white-label coins to the national bank. Those plans do not establish a current GENIUS issuer pathway. September 2026 issuer disclosure still calls the proposed bank non-operational. Bridge/Stripe GENIUS-ready Open Issuance marketing supports issuer-announced-intent only, not PPSI approval or an official application. No established GENIUS pathway or primary federal payment-stablecoin regulator for current BBI issuance was found. Quarterly-described attestations and monthly activity reports do not establish monthly independent reserve attestations. Section 20 gives January 18, 2027 as the 18-month date subject to the earlier-final-rule trigger; no earlier trigger was established by the checked proposal/procedural materials. The separate three-year DASP transition does not establish a current offer/sale prohibition. USDB remains pre-launch in the supplied catalogue: no lifecycle metadata change is proposed.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific PPSI/state-qualified grant or official GENIUS application for USDB or its current issuer Bridge Building Inc. was located in these checked materials. The opened OCC record approves organization of a separate proposed bank conditionally under existing charter authority, not BBI or USDB under GENIUS. No public GENIUS enforcement action naming the current issuer/token was located in the scoped searches. This is a dated, bounded public-evidence review, not an assertion that no application has been filed, no nonpublic matter exists, or no issuer anywhere has approval.
